_comment: Token-drift allowlist (UI-FE-091 / #665). Each entry documents a legitimate exception to the forbidden raw-value rules defined in docs/design-system/COMPONENT_DEPRECATION_POLICY.md. The 'baseline' count must equal the number of entries in 'exceptions'. CI fails if the live count grows above 'approved' without a corresponding update.

exceptions.reason: recharts data-visualisation library requires raw colour values for CartesianGrid, Line and Bar fills. The CSS-variable tokens are not reachable inside SVG paint attributes in all target browsers. Consumers must still label series with accessible text; colour alone does not carry meaning.

RainbowKit ConnectButton overrides require matching the external library's internal colour scheme. The wrapper class is intentionally isolated and has no semantic-token equivalent. Reviewed against upstream RainbowKit theming API.

Pre-existing skeleton components introduced before the V2 token contract (UI-FE-091 baseline). These files use raw hex from the legacy dark palette. Migration to semantic tokens is tracked as a follow-up. Do NOT add new skeleton files to this exemption — use token utilities from day one.

Pre-existing feature components introduced before the V2 token contract (UI-FE-091 baseline). These files contain raw hex, inline margins, and inline padding from the pre-token era. Migration is tracked as a follow-up. Do NOT add new feature files to this exemption — use token utilities from day one.

Pre-existing Trust* UI components introduced before the V2 token contract (UI-FE-091 baseline). Migration to semantic tokens is tracked as a follow-up. Do NOT add new Trust* components to this exemption without review.
